blocks.text: If the city commission at any time chooses to abandon the project, then and in that event, the consulting engineers shall be reimbursed in accordance with the provisions of Chapter 2, Article 14, Code of the City of Topeka, 1969, and amendments thereto. (C.O. 17 § 6, 1-30-71.)
